methods.label: LME random intercept + random slope
methods.formula: Y染色体浓度 ~ 孕周 + BMI + (1 + 孕周 | 孕妇代码)

evidence.note: statsmodels mixedlm REML converged; random slope model LL=2594 vs intercept-only LL=2515

assumption_checks.name: within_subject_correlation
assumption_checks.note: ICC=0.60 confirms strong clustering; mixed model is necessary, pooled OLS would badly underestimate SE

assumption_checks.name: multicollinearity_body_composition
assumption_checks.note: BMI(218.6), height(106.9), weight(351.4) are near-perfectly collinear. Mitigation: retain only BMI as the composite body-composition predictor; drop height and weight from the model. After dropping, BMI VIF drops to <2

assumption_checks.name: residual_normality
assumption_checks.note: Shapiro-Wilk p<0.001 on subsample but skew=0.58 is moderate. LME coefficient estimates are consistent under non-normality for n=1082; SE robustness can be verified with sandwich estimator. Fallback to Beta GLMM if residual diagnostics worsen

assumption_checks.name: response_distribution
assumption_checks.note: Y conc is bounded (0,1) and right-skewed. LME assumes unbounded normal response. Practical range 0.01-0.23 is far from boundaries, so normal approximation is tolerable. Monitor predicted values for boundary violations

assumption_checks.name: ivf_covariate_power
assumption_checks.note: Only 17/1082 IVF cases (1.6%). Insufficient power to detect IVF effect reliably. Recommend: include as exploratory covariate but do not claim significance

metrics.note: Both fixed effects non-zero and significant. Random effects variances are small but positive, model does not degenerate to pooled OLS

perturbation_sensitivity.perturbation: BMI ± 1 unit shift on all observations
perturbation_sensitivity.note: Gestational week coefficient stable under BMI perturbation; BMI coefficient stable under 10% random dropout of subjects

scale_check.note: Full dataset fits in <1s. No scaling concern

conditions: Must exclude height and weight from model to resolve multicollinearity (retain BMI only)
Monitor residual diagnostics; if skew exceeds 1.0 or predicted values approach 0/1 boundary, activate M3 (Beta GLMM)

methods.label: Pooled OLS multiple regression
methods.formula: Y染色体浓度 ~ 孕周 + BMI

assumption_checks.name: independence_violation
assumption_checks.note: Pooled OLS assumes independent observations. ICC=0.60 means observations within the same patient are strongly correlated. Standard errors are underestimated and p-values are anti-conservative. This is a known and accepted limitation of the baseline — its purpose is to quantify the improvement from mixed-effects modeling

metrics.note: Both coefficients significant (though p-values are anti-conservative due to clustering). R-squared is low but expected for descriptive inference task with high individual variability

conditions: Standard errors are known to be underestimated due to clustering. Report alongside M1 for comparison only, not as standalone inference

methods.label: Beta GLMM (logit link)
methods.formula: logit(Y染色体浓度) ~ 孕周 + BMI + (1 + 孕周 | 孕妇代码)
methods.trigger: M1 residual skew > 1.0 OR predicted values approach 0/1 boundary OR likelihood-ratio test of nonlinear terms p<0.01

executability.note: Beta GLMM requires glmmTMB (R) or custom implementation. Feasibility confirmed conceptually; full convergence test deferred until trigger fires

conditions: Activate only if M1 residual diagnostics fail trigger criteria
